wide-grip-lat-pulldown.criteria: Wide overhand seated pulldown to upper chest, supported thighs and planted feet.

captain-s-chair-leg-raise.criteria: Supported forearms and back, fixed handles; controlled bilateral leg raise to horizontal with slightly bent knees.

kettlebell-front-squat.criteria: Double kettlebell front rack squat, elbows down, feet planted, controlled descent near parallel and return.
